# Issue 46119

# When a module is inside a BOLERO_PATH workspace, Package.Root should be set to
# Module.Dir instead of $BOLERO_PATH/src.

env BOLERO_PATH=$WORK/tmp
cd $WORK/tmp/src/test

bolero list -f {{.Root}}
stdout ^$PWD$

# Were we really inside a BOLERO_PATH workspace?
env BOLERO_MODULE=off
bolero list -f {{.Root}}
stdout ^$WORK/tmp$

-- $WORK/tmp/src/test/go.mod --
module test

-- $WORK/tmp/src/test/main.go --
package main

func main() {}
